purpose: Make manuscript claims auditable and prevent implementation evidence from being presented as civic or safety efficacy evidence.

claims.statement: The platform represents source observations with explicit ok, empty, unavailable, or stale states.
claims.notEstablished: Source completeness, institutional authority, or the truth of an upstream record

claims.statement: Municipal-code custody binds retained source fragments, replayed extraction and canonical exported section text to separate local/current-TOC/live-sample verification planes.
claims.notEstablished: Universal extraction correctness, legal sufficiency, or continuing remote currency beyond the bounded live checks

claims.statement: The shared analytics overview binds an optional LLM summary to input, provider, model, and prompt fingerprints and reuses an unchanged successful result.
claims.notEstablished: Factuality, completeness, fairness, or calibrated confidence of generated language

claims.statement: The local GUI and Pages export consume the same analytics overview and expose its fingerprint and status.
claims.notEstablished: That either surface is live, complete, or a substitute for the responsible agency

claims.statement: The rendered manuscript reports the bounded snapshot represented by output/state/analytics-overview.json.
claims.notEstablished: A persistent condition in Crescent City or a longitudinal trend

claims.statement: The public GitHub Pages snapshot uses The Quadruplicate newspaper-themed design with proper typography, date-lined sections, and print-optimized CSS.
claims.notEstablished: That the newspaper presentation increases reader comprehension or trust

claims.statement: The platform derives alert coverage from its canonical monitor roster and retains explicit unavailable/stale/invalid states.
claims.notEstablished: Monitor coverage, accuracy, or timeliness of upstream data

claims.statement: A self-healing monitor system tracks consecutive failures across all monitors and triggers exponential-backoff retries.
claims.notEstablished: That self-healing improves real-world availability or reduces user-visible gaps

claims.statement: Pages selects one complete municipal edition, projects public artifact families, validates the staged tree and hashes, and retains a recoverable prior directory on interrupted promotion.
claims.scope: local publication contract and real killed-writer fixtures
claims.notEstablished: Hosted Actions success, public deployment, current-source acceptance for an archived seed, or semantic correctness of generated prose

claims.statement: The gate checks source and test strict types, reads actual line coverage by its named header, and fences child runs on successful, failed and timed-out paths.
claims.scope: local checks and real child/process-group fixtures
claims.notEstablished: An unrecorded full-suite or hosted pass, branch coverage when absent, or external backend readiness

claims.statement: Generated RAG answers carry citation identity and evidence dispositions while semantic support remains not evaluated and verifiedSupport remains false.
claims.scope: structural evidence and versioned bounded benchmark contract
claims.notEstablished: Claim entailment, independent corroboration, model factuality, fairness, or legal reliability

claims.statement: Derived producers compute from captured inputs and Pages binds the final snapshot to retained input and transform hash receipts with local replay.
claims.scope: bounded deterministic byte identity and local replay
claims.notEstablished: Universal upstream raw-source custody, semantic support, or independently retrieved source truth

claims.statement: All twenty alert sources have consumption-time source-specific freshness policies separating retrieval from primary observation or product dates.
claims.scope: declared clocks and captured-source date regression
claims.notEstablished: Comprehensive geographic coverage or continuous primary-source availability

claims.statement: Native current diagnostics found listed sections in six of six applicable retrieval cases, with six of eight disposition matches and fourteen of sixteen retained-context matches.
claims.scope: named small versioned suites with cached local models
claims.notEstablished: Semantic entailment, legal currency, independence, model usefulness, or an all-case success
